criteria.description: Every doc_type: decision document carries a `## Decision log` section, and the validator enforces its grammar.
criteria.evidence: tests/docs_standards/test_adr_corpus.py::test_every_adr_has_a_decision_log_and_it_is_last (9 ADRs) + test_validator_scoping.py decision-log cases; validate_docs.py passes with decision_log promoted to a blocker.
criteria.notes: Verified in lane-e, which has all six work packages merged.

criteria.description: An entry lives in the ADR it is ABOUT. The originating defect — ADR-0008's erratum filed in ADR-0004's log — is corrected by relocation, not duplication.
criteria.evidence: test_adr_corpus.py::test_adr0008_surfaces_its_own_erratum and ::test_the_relocated_erratum_is_not_duplicated_as_a_canonical_row (structural: ADR-0004's canonical log carries exactly its three authorised rows and no erratum).
criteria.notes: Verified in lane-e, which has all six work packages merged.

criteria.description: The log table has fixed columns with a controlled Type vocabulary, enforced.
criteria.evidence: test_validator_scoping.py: wrong-header, separator-cardinality, column-count, Type-vocabulary, ISO-date and contiguity cases all reject; escaped-pipe accepted.
criteria.notes: Verified in lane-e, which has all six work packages merged.

criteria.description: Permitted statuses depend on doc_type: a decision may use `superseded`, an ordinary doc may not, and `active` is invalid for a decision.
criteria.evidence: test_validator_scoping.py::test_decision_may_use_superseded / ::test_ordinary_doc_may_not_use_superseded / ::test_decision_may_not_use_active; conditional JSON Schema proven in test_generator.py.
criteria.notes: Verified in lane-e, which has all six work packages merged.

criteria.description: allowed-values.json is the single enforced source; the schema and the narrative status list are generated from it, and the loader is fail-closed.
criteria.evidence: generate_doc_standards.py --check passes; test_doc_taxonomy.py 41 cases (every malformed shape raises); test_generator.py idempotency + region-scoping.
criteria.notes: Verified in lane-e, which has all six work packages merged.

criteria.description: The contract survives --no-verify: the freshness check runs in CI as well as the pre-commit hook.
criteria.evidence: test_gate_wiring.py asserts the hook runs --check AND feeds `fail`, CI runs it, and CI triggers cover push-to-main. Proven live: staling frontmatter.schema.json failed --check (exit 1, named the file) and failed the hook; restoring cleared both.
criteria.notes: Verified in lane-e, which has all six work packages merged.

criteria.description: Frontmatter is authoritative for standing; new ADRs carry no body Status line.
criteria.evidence: docs/_templates/decision.md emits one frontmatter block with doc_type: decision and no body Status line; test_adr_template.py renders the template and runs the real validator over the result with decision_log promoted.
criteria.notes: Verified in lane-e, which has all six work packages merged.

criteria.description: ADRs 0001-0009 migrated onto the contract, with state formerly held as prose in README.md/INDEX.md seeded into each ADR's own log.
criteria.evidence: test_adr_corpus.py MATRIX table-drives all nine: exact target status and exact (date, Type) rows per the migration matrix; empty logs must be exactly `*No entries.*`.
criteria.notes: Verified in lane-e, which has all six work packages merged.

criteria.description: The ADR README records the doctrine — three separated roles, the status table, no partially_superseded, and the entry-lives-in-its-own-ADR rule.
criteria.evidence: docs/design/architecture/adr/README.md; test_adr_corpus.py::test_indexes_carry_no_parenthetical_state asserts both index tables no longer smuggle state.
criteria.notes: Verified in lane-e, which has all six work packages merged.

criteria.description: The two known amendments are seeded in the documents they concern.
criteria.notes: Verified in lane-e, which has all six work packages merged.

negative_invariants.description: `partially_superseded` never exists — not in frontmatter, not as prose in an index.
negative_invariants.evidence: test_adr_corpus.py::test_no_adr_carries_partially_superseded across all nine ADRs; the status is absent from allowed-values.json.

negative_invariants.description: Frontmatter validation never reaches spec-kitty-owned trees, while secret scanning still covers kitty-specs/.
negative_invariants.evidence: test_validator_scoping.py::test_spec_kitty_trees_are_never_frontmatter_validated and ::test_secret_scanning_still_covers_kitty_specs. The second guards the dangerous misreading: a literal 'never walk' test would have disabled secret coverage.

negative_invariants.description: ADR bodies are frozen — migration touches frontmatter and appends a section only.
negative_invariants.evidence: test_adr_corpus.py::test_adr0004_legacy_log_is_preserved_verbatim compares the frozen ACL-changes section byte-for-byte against its pre-migration revision.

negative_invariants.description: The generator never writes outside its own region, and never silently produces output from fallbacks.
negative_invariants.evidence: test_generator.py prose-preservation, sentinel strictness (missing/duplicate/partial/reversed/fenced/inline), foreign-allOf preservation, and fail-closed-on-malformed-source.

negative_invariants.description: The suite floor is held: no test regressed.
negative_invariants.evidence: 6682 passed in lane-e against a 6490 baseline (+192). The single failure, tests/deploy/test_tick_rebaseline.py, is pre-existing on main and tracked as #989 — reproduced on a clean main before this mission changed anything.
